messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "place the mixture in a sealed container such as a plastic bag and throw it away in the household trash"
set: ["place the mixture in a sealed container such as a plastic bag and throw it away in the household trash", "throw the bag in the trash", "store in a safe place such as a locked cabinet", "mix leftover medicine with cat litter or coffee grounds in a sealed plastic bag", "do not put in household trash", "place it in a puncture-proof sharps container and dispose of it following state or local laws", "keep in a closed container", "store in a dry place", "place needles and syringes in puncture-proof sharps container", "do not inject into the same place twice in a row", "swallow all of the mixture right away", "drink all of the mixture right away", "keep canister away from open flame or high heat, such as in a car on a hot day", "place the oral granules directly in your mouth and swallow", "store in dry place away from moisture", "keep tablets and capsules in a tightly closed light-resistant container with a child-resistant cap"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
